description:
[DESTRUCTIVE] Disconnects the brand's Mercatus Liber store, the same as "Disconnect store" in the dashboard: removes the connection, its stored key and the imported products and collections (drafts are kept). Refuses a Shopify App Store connection. `brandId` is required on an account-wide connection. Needs the explicit `stores:manage` scope plus `write`. Confirm with the user first.
(Wraps DELETE /api/v2/stores/mercatus/connect.)

brandId.description: The brand (GET /api/v2/brands). Required for an account-wide key; a brand-bound key may omit it.

name: mercatus_store_disconnect
title: Disconnect the brand's Mercatus store
